projects.title: Pan-African Social Listening & Trend Analytics
projects.narrative_md:
Architected an automated data pipeline to monitor, scrape, and analyze macroeconomic and consumer trends across South Africa, Kenya, and Nigeria.

Implemented advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) and sentiment analysis workflows to extract cultural nuances and brand insights from massive streams of unstructured text data.

Transformed multi-country behavioral datasets into structured intelligence to fuel regional market strategies and corporate decision-making.
